reason: The agent accepted and booked a party of ten, but tables are only for 1 to 8 guests and larger parties must be referred elsewhere.
name: Too many guests booked

spec.goal: Book a table for a family celebration.
spec.behavior: You sound happy and a bit celebratory. Give the party size and time in one short message, then your name when asked. If they read back the details and ask to book, confirm once and end the call after they say the table is booked.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent does not book the table and instead says they cannot take a party that large at the restaurant.
